openTimes.what: timing-checks-in-the-page's library-open.mjs: a fresh profile per module and round; once the default Main is checked, Enter on the module's Explorer row; the question answered Fetch (or Check from source); mountMs from the answer (or the Enter, when nothing is asked) to the heading's 'Loading <module>…'; loadS the page's own duration of the load; checking the count of Checking lines of the load (an Infer of Set shows the compiler log); hoverMs from the pointer's arrival on the last character of a word to the language server's tooltip.  Then a reload in the same profile and the same module opened again (the second visit).

source.what: One round, the question answered Check from source; then a reload, where the declined archives are remembered for the tab and the drive's cache restores the interfaces Agda wrote.

notes: 'a library module editable' first ran with an edit that put an undefined extension in the state, which crashed the page; it was run again with the read-only document left out, and failed where it should.

'a library module written when it is loaded (its text given to the load)' passed: the drive treats a write of identical bytes as no change (replaceFileContent in drive.ts), so it is neither marked dirty nor persisted, and leaves nothing to see.  With a changed text (a newline added) the check failed: Agda type-checked the module again.

'hover positions in UTF-16 code units' first passed, since the step hovered over a word's second character, where a shift of two code points stays in the word; the step now hovers over the word's last character, and the control fails with the server's error for the token two characters to the right.
controls.revisions: The first seven ran at cbec2c4, an unpushed earlier version of 38ecdc2 whose hover step pointed at a word's second character; the other four at 38ecdc2.  The browser checks in browserCheck ran at the revision above, which adds the review's fixes.

siteLinks.what: Each of the 350 modules of the page's pin probed at https://agda-algebras.universalalgebra.org/<A>/<B>/ (curl, at the time given).

copyRules.what: The page's own moduleCopy and selectionCopy (src/lib/playground.ts, imported by node 22 with --experimental-strip-types) over agda-algebras' sources at the pin, each copy checked by the native Agda 2.9.0 at the page's compiler commit (/nix/store/1axa6adsvwbz7wbck03d7wbsfdr1x8hq-Agda-2.9.0-bin) with the page's standard library and agda-algebras' interfaces built natively, in a project like the playground's (depend: standard-library-2.3 agda-algebras, include: .).  Not the page's reactor: the verdicts are Agda's at the same commit; the page's own copies are in the browser check.

wholeModule.copies: every module, as /<project>/W<k>.lagda.md, its module line renamed

selection.copies: for every module, the last code block that defines something, as a selection (278 modules have one), as /<project>/M<k>.agda: the module's code through the selection
selection.comparison: A shorter rule, the selection under the module's imports and `open import <module> <args> hiding (<names the selection defines>)`, checked 225 of the same 278 (198 of 204 top-level, 27 of 74 indented); the selection under the module's imports alone fails whenever it uses a name defined above it in its module (NotInScope; OperationSymbolsOf and ArityOf in Overture.Signatures, which use Signature).

switchingBack.what: Copilot's first round on PR 93 said that a file shown again keeps stale goals when the session still holds it, its load marked unchecked.  A PLFA chapter (part1/Naturals) with a declaration zz : ℕ, zz = {! !} appended was checked; another chapter was shown (mounted, not loaded, so Agda still held Naturals); Naturals was shown again, `zero` typed into the hole, and Ctrl-c Ctrl-Space pressed.  The control shows Main between them instead, whose automatic check makes Agda hold Main.  Headless Chromium 149, 2026-10-13, at 6fb6e44.

heldStill.give: taken: the line reads 'zz = zero', no error

switchingBack.finding: Goals a file shows again while Agda still holds its load are Agda's live goals (a give is taken); reloadNext's mark only makes the next check a load.  When Agda holds another file the goals are cleared and goal commands refused.
